content.text: It would be helpful if the template also gave guidance on the pull-request title, like:
The title should be a brief description of what the pull-request fixes/improves/changes... ideally 50 characters or less.
Cool. You want anymore input on this? Fedora Tech call... which would probably be April 13th?
I don't think there is any controversy here. Feel free to make a pull-request and we can move it forward.
I'm going to propose that we use this template as a basis:
Please discuss any changes in comments below. Once we have consensus, I'll issue PRs across all the projects.
